conbody.p: After about an hour of driving with the driver’s seat belt fastened, the posture assist function automatically turns on and assists the driver’s posture by adjusting the driver’s seat’s hips and waist parts.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleSeatsErgo-motion seatPosture Assist from the infotainment system.
If you press the seat adjustment switch (cushion support, lumbar support, bolster adjustment device) while the posture assist function is operating, the operation stops.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: If both conditions below are satisfied, the posture assist function automatically operates to assist the driver’s posture.

li.p: The vehicle is in ON position
The driver’s side seatbelt is fastened
